description: Get customer-facing details of an audience, including expanded segment summaries and composition. Use when the user wants to inspect a specific saved audience. An expired audience may have its stored status synchronized to expired during this read; no build or count is started. Requires 'discovery' scope.

audience_id.description: The audience ID returned by list_audiences or create_audience

name: get_audience

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

record_count.description: Saved composition count; null is unknown. Use recount_audience for a current value.

set_logic.description: How included segments combine; excluded segments always subtract

title: Get Audience
